items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jimmy Garrison. Me and him and Jimmy Garrison.

ctx.x: Jimmy Garrison. Me and him and Jimmy Garrison. We worked in Jimmy McPhail’s for a week or so, I think. And there was the Caverns. We worked down there for Tony, a couple times, when it was Bohemian Caverns.
